semantics.geometry: continuous determinant lower bounds and numerical sampled-P1 legality are separate; per-face mu is recomputed from edge Jacobians
semantics.random: CPU float64 directed positive-Tutte targets at H=1; strengths are logit scales, not prescribed distortion or condition numbers
semantics.accuracy: not evaluated: no self-map or self-mu zero errors; only actual fitted outputs may be compared with an audited target
semantics.domain: a topologically valid analytic map can leave the unit square and be unsuitable for the in-range registration sampler
semantics.images: identity and positive-x pixel shift plus independent NumPy bilinear oracle; boundary-sliding dense target audited before oracle use
semantics.inverse_consistency: not evaluated: no inverse map is constructed
